# Acoustical Surfaces

> > Acoustical Surfaces provides comprehensive soundproofing and acoustic treatment solutions for diverse applications from offices to healthcare facilities.

Acoustical Surfaces specializes in acoustic panels, sound-blocking materials, and noise control products including flagship solutions like Echo Eliminator, Sound Silencer, and Echo Barrier. The company serves multiple industries with ANSI-compliant, LEED-certified materials and offers technical resources, international distribution, and customer support.

## Key Topics

- Acoustic Panels
- Sound Silencer
- Echo Eliminator
- Noise Control
- Sound Absorption
- Soundproofing Solutions
- Green Glue
- Mass Loaded Vinyl
- RSIC Clips
- Echo Barrier
- Sound Insulation
- Acoustic Treatment
- Class A Rating
- LEED-Certified Materials
- Soundproof Doors & Windows

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [Sound Absorbing Panels for Offices](https://www.acousticalsurfaces.com/office-environments): Office soundproofing solutions including acoustic panels and door seals
- [Soundproofing Classrooms](https://www.acousticalsurfaces.com/educational-institutions): Classroom soundproofing to improve speech intelligibility and learning
- [Noise Reduction Healthcare and Hospital Ceiling Tiles](https://www.acousticalsurfaces.com/health-care): Hospital and healthcare facility soundproofing with acoustic ceiling tiles
- [Venue & Media Room Soundproofing](https://www.acousticalsurfaces.com/entertainment): Entertainment venue and home theater soundproofing with acoustic panels
- [Noise Control & Soundproofing Correctional Facilities](https://www.acousticalsurfaces.com/correctional-facilities): Soundproofing solutions for correctional facilities with specialized products
- [Building Soundproof Wall Construction](https://www.acousticalsurfaces.com/general-building): Soundproof wall construction materials including RSIC clips and Green Glue
